title: Projects & Case Studies
subtitle: Detailed documentation of software platforms, tools, and libraries built for real-world impact.

projects.title: Sentinel Core
projects.shortDescription: Distributed event-driven orchestration engine with observable state machine boundaries.
projects.detailedDescription: An enterprise-grade orchestration runtime implementing Clean Architecture and strict static typing. Coordinates long-running workflows with deterministic state persistence and recovery guarantees.
projects.imageAlt: Architectural diagram showing state machine event transitions and database isolation boundaries in Sentinel Core

projects.title: Prism Design System
projects.shortDescription: Zero-dependency accessible component tokens and semantic layout engine for enterprise web apps.
projects.detailedDescription: A multi-brand design system built entirely with CSS custom properties and WCAG 2.2 AA compliant markup. Features high-contrast themes, keyboard trap prevention, and complete screen-reader compatibility.
projects.imageAlt: Visual token hierarchy preview displaying color scales, typography scales, and keyboard focus states in Prism

projects.title: Vanguard Metrics
projects.shortDescription: Real-time telemetry aggregator processing system events with low-latency in-memory buffers.
projects.detailedDescription: High-throughput monitoring daemon designed for microservices deployed across heterogeneous container environments. Exports OpenTelemetry standard metrics with minimal CPU footprint.
projects.imageAlt: Metrics dashboard overview illustrating real-time request rates, latency percentiles, and error tracking

projects.title: Kestrel Build Runner
projects.shortDescription: Secure sandbox executor running isolated untrusted scripts inside unprivileged containers.
projects.detailedDescription: A hardened execution agent featuring strict path traversal prevention, memory quotas, dropped Linux capabilities, and automated stale-container reclamation.
projects.imageAlt: Security boundary schematic showing sandbox container isolation, memory bounds, and workspace volume mounts
